title: Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch Premier League 2026-27

 Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch Premier League 2026-27
 By Sushruta Follow Add as Preferred Source From football pitches to bookshelves, always chasing a good story. Published at : October 24, 2026 at 10:02 PM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 24, 2026 at 10:02 PM (GMT+5:30) Both sides won their last league match.
 Chelsea will host Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge in a Matchday 8 fixture of the Premier League 2026-27 on Saturday, October 24. After a tough start to the season, Spurs secured their first win of the season last week. But they will still be the underdogs against the Blues.
 A clinical 2-0 win against Everton, powered by a brace from Pedro Neto, marked Chelsea ’s second consecutive win. This was preceded by a 5-1 demolition of AFC Bournemouth, which featured braces from Jordan Henderson and Joao Pedro.
 The Blues currently sit in fourth place with 13 points. They can cut down their deficit from the top to four points with a win. The hosts are on a terrific streak against Tottenham Hotspur , having won their last six Premier League matches against their London rivals.
 In fact, Spurs have won just once in their last 36 Premier League matches at Stamford Bridge, with the win coming in 2018. The Lilywhites have made a tough start to their league campaign this season, securing their first win only in the seventh round.
 Goals from James Maddison, Omar Marmoush, and Ben Davies secured a 3-1 win over Coventry City for Roberto De Zerbi’s side. They currently sit in 17th place, level on six points with Coventry one place below them.

 Where and how to live stream Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur in India?
 This match will be live-streamed online in India on the JioHotstar app and website. The television broadcast will take place on the Star Sports Select 1 (SD & HD) channel.
 Where and how to watch this Premier League game live in the UK?
 Fans in the UK can watch this match live on Sky Sports.
 Where and how to watch Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur live in Nigeria?
 This match will be shown live in Nigeria via SuperSport and Canal+.
 Where and how to watch Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur live in the USA?
 Fans in the USA can watch this match live by tuning in to NBC Sports and Universo.
 When is Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur match in the Premier League 2026-27?
 The match will take place on Saturday, October 24, 2026, with kick-off scheduled for 10:00 PM IST.
 Where will Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur be played?
 The match will be played at Stamford Bridge in London, England, as part of the Premier League 2026-27 season.
 Where to watch Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur live in India?
 The match will be live-streamed on the JioHotstar app and website in India, with television coverage on Star Sports Select 1 (SD and HD).
